purpose: Test the first byte-scope-proven selective CQ3 rung on the runnable Qwen3.8-27B CPU control

scope.candidate_kind: direct selective PTQ from the pinned Q4_K_M runtime control
scope.claim_boundary: one Qwen3.8-27B layer-0 MLP triplet only; not QAT, not BF16-exact PTQ, not a whole-model ternary result, and not a breakthrough claim

tensor_scope.required_non_target_identity: all 848 non-target tensor names, shapes, types, payload sizes, and payload SHA-256 values must be identical to the baseline

conversion.copy_semantics: COPY preserves each unmatched tensor's current GGML type and raw bytes; only the first matching explicit override may be requantized
conversion.source_precision_boundary: the three CQ3 tensors are produced from dequantized Q4_K payloads, not from the BF16 parent

pre_quality_gates: the Qwen3.8-27B Q4 baseline quality marker and summary must exist
test-cq3 must pass in the isolated candidate build
the conversion log must contain exactly the three preregistered selective COPY overrides
the candidate byte count must equal 18894489952
the GGUF scope verifier must prove all non-target payloads byte-identical and all three targets changed from type 12 to type 43
a single-turn candidate load smoke must complete without swap
promotion_rules: No reconstruction loss or successful load can promote the candidate
Any non-target GGUF payload difference invalidates the candidate
Infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed score
The candidate must be compared to the exact pinned Q4 control on the exact frozen manifests
A one-layer pass authorizes only one separately preregistered deeper Qwen3.8-27B rung
